hooks.name: TDD Reminder
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to consider writing tests when new C# source files are created

action.prompt: A new C# source file was just created under src/. Consider whether this file needs corresponding test coverage. If it contains logic that should be tested, suggest creating a test file in the appropriate tests/ project following TDD principles. This project uses xUnit + Moq with 6 test projects.
